verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs show agent credentials minted from Dev Dashboard client credentials as short-lived JWTs with a 60-minute TTL. The tokens carry scopes: get_order requires the `read_global_api_orders` scope, and complete_checkout works only when the token is granted permission to complete purchases. Tiered identification (Token/Signed/Anonymous) gates access to more sensitive tools, and AP2 adds pre-defined, verifiable transaction boundaries. Missing for 10: documentation of how a user selects or restricts scopes when issuing a credential, a full scope catalog, revocation and per-agent credential management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped token issuance.
